field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: The three mandated GGUF model rows are resolved through cached SOTA helper calls.
field_principles.arm_definitions: Defines random, repeated sampling, stability, and counterexample-directed proposal arms.
field_principles.counterexample_minimizer_path_hash_and_e: Pins the minimizer and proves each counterexample is exact and minimal.
field_principles.counterexample_proposal_ready_score: Readiness is one only when counterexample-directed proposals beat repeated sampling per matched cost in every required family and all checks pass.
field_principles.cuda_gpu_offload_and_memory_release_rece: Records GPU offload and per-model release receipts before and after generation.
field_principles.development_event_manifest_path_and_hash: Freezes development events, split hashes, seeds, budgets, and protected seal hashes.
field_principles.duration_s: Reports measured wall time without padding.
field_principles.exact_oracle_claim_boundary: States that exact checkers are the oracle and release authority.
field_principles.exact_proposal_success_cost_and_movement: Reports exact success, checker cost, and movement per model family and arm.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why every required field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps every field to specs, inputs, sidecars, model receipts, tests, or exact checks.
field_principles.generated_label_count: Bare zero proves generated labels did not enter scoring.
field_principles.harm_underpowered_missing_and_flagged_ce: Keeps missing, underpowered, harmful, or flagged cells visible.
field_principles.hidden_state_access_count: Bare zero proves hidden activations did not enter scoring.
field_principles.honest_verdict: States the terminal claim boundary with a terminal prefix.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares local GGUF llama.cpp proposal generation with exact checking.
field_principles.information_exposure_contract: Defines the only fields visible to the proposer.
field_principles.llama_cpp_embedded_tokenizer_receipts: Proves tokenizer checks used embedded GGUF metadata through llama.cpp.
field_principles.matched_call_token_candidate_time_and_ch: Proves budget parity across all arms.
field_principles.model_file_hashes_revisions_quantization: Pins model files, snapshot revisions, quantizations, tokenizer method, and file hashes.
field_principles.models_used: Names the model ids that supplied bounded proposal rows.
field_principles.paired_deltas_intervals_and_sample_sizes: Reports preregistered paired deltas against repeated sampling.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Freezes upstream readiness, GGUF files, embedded tokenizers, GPUs, VRAM, RAM, disk, timeouts, seeds, event hashes, budgets, and protected hashes.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows conductor, ops, traceability, and upstream files stayed byte-identical.
field_principles.protected_outcome_seal_and_single_open_r: Shows protected outcomes opened once after selection.
field_principles.protected_validation_leak_count: Bare zero proves no protected outcome leaked before selection.
field_principles.random_seeds: Pins deterministic proposal and split schedules.
field_principles.raw_proposal_paths_hashes_and_counts: Pins raw proposal rows and counts before exact scoring.
field_principles.schema_validity_and_factor_locality_resu: Reports schema validity, factor locality, variable locality, and edit-bound failures.
field_principles.source_model_weight_mutation_count: Bare zero proves source model weights were not updated.
field_principles.status: Terminal state follows proposal success, locality, single-open, protected files, tests, and exact cost checks.
field_principles.test_commands: Lists run, focused, coverage, global, spec, E2E, and adversarial commands.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Prevents failed commands from becoming readiness.
field_principles.upstream_paths_hashes_terminal_classes_a: Upstream Exp6319, Exp6342, and Exp6343 bytes and ready scores are replayed first.
field_principles.verification_calls_time_cost_and_error_t: Reports checker calls, checker time, cost, and errors.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Bare true preserves the exact checker as authority.
